subject: Human Body
title: Nail Fungus and Infections
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Nail Fungus and Infections.

hook.text: Yellowish, thick, crumbling nails aren't cosmetic.

buildup.text: Dermatophytes are fungi that feed on keratin.

discovery.text: Topical treatments rarely work alone because the nail plate blocks penetration.

twist.text: Toenail fungus affects 10% of adults and 50% of people over 70.

climax.text: Nail fungus exploits keratin as food and the nail plate as shelter.

punchline.text: Nail fungus hides under keratin armor. That's why it's so hard to kill.

quiz.question: Why are topical antifungals often ineffective for nail fungus?
options: Nail fungus is resistant to all known medications
The nail plate blocks medication from reaching the fungus underneath
Fungi only respond to antibiotics, not antifungals
